purpose: Source-backed anti-amputation overlay for durable lineages and owner laws recovered after the initial Total Brain draft.

entries.name: UberBond Growth Graph Expansion
entries.donation: Compose discovery, enrichment, channel, content, attribution, payment, delivery and economic learning into one growth graph; prevent disconnected clone systems.

entries.name: Cost -> Stage -> Fulfill -> Learn Spine
entries.donation: Bind evidence acquisition cost, staged assets, fulfilment, cleared-contribution/founder-minute receipts and bounded economic learning.

entries.name: Autonomous Agent Mesh V1
entries.donation: Bounded multi-model work graph and control plane for replaceable workers, durable tasks, evidence refs, permissions, replay safety and unattended execution.

entries.name: Agent Relay Bus
entries.donation: GPT <-> UberBond <-> Claude provider-neutral typed task bus with shared memory/evidence, permission/result contracts, routing and disagreement/arbiter semantics.

entries.name: V5 Evidence Kernel / SLIM_TO_V5
entries.donation: Small sufficient context plus retrieval, deterministic policy/tiny instructions, evidence contracts, external-gate boundaries and held-out promotion discipline.

entries.name: Cloneable Market Feature Inventory
entries.donation: Decompose observable market software into reusable workflow/capability atoms rather than building one clone per competitor.

entries.name: Sender Infrastructure Mesh
entries.donation: Sender/domain/provider-purpose, authentication, reputation, suppression, uncertainty/reconciliation, idempotency and concentration controls.

entries.name: Evidence-to-Content Compiler
entries.donation: Turn source-backed evidence into provenance-preserving, limitation-aware distribution/content assets tied to offers and routes.

entries.name: World Brain Field Mission
entries.donation: Source-backed public opportunity, partner, capability and first-cash research beyond repository-local context with zero business-effect authority until promoted.

ownerLaws: Customer acquisition and economic proof are UberBond responsibilities; pre-customer engineering completion must not make the founder the permanent manual salesperson/operator.
Revenue generation and self-improvement run in parallel: operate -> earn -> observe -> learn -> improve -> operate better -> earn more.
Founder work should collapse toward genuinely human-exclusive actions such as MFA, KYC/identity confirmation, new paid commitments and legally required personal decisions.
Maintain separate engineering-readiness, commercial-proof, autonomy/founder-minute and self-improvement/economic-lift scoreboards rather than one vanity completion percentage.
